summary: Verified the chart-loading bug fix on the Trading page via real browser E2E test. Unlocked app with API_ACCESS_TOKEN, navigated to Trading page, selected a stock (FGI) from the scanner grid (clicking the ticker adds it to both the buy-selection and the multi-chart view), and confirmed all 4 underlying API calls (1Min bars, 5Min bars, 1Day bars with use_fallback=false, quote) returned HTTP 200 - none returned 502/Cloudflare HTML. Candlestick chart rendered fully with SMA20/SMA50/VWAP overlays, entry/stop/target lines, and volume bars, using intraday (1Min/5Min) Yahoo-fallback data even though daily bars were empty (source='none', no_historical_data=true for 1Day) - exactly the graceful degradation behavior described in the fix. No stray '}' artifact found near the chart area. Regression-checked Dashboard, Scanner, Settings, and History pages - all load without errors.

minor.issue: Occasionally returns HTTP 500 with body {"detail": "...too many requests..."} when Alpaca rate-limits the underlying call (observed via curl on AAPL, resolved on retry ~15s later). This endpoint is one of the 4 in the same Promise.all as the fixed bars endpoint - a transient 500 here would still cascade-fail the whole chart load the same way the old 502 did (though 500 responses are less likely to be intercepted/rewritten by Cloudflare edge like 502 was, so this is lower severity than the original bug, but the same root-cause pattern applies). Not in scope of this fix request but worth flagging since it shares the exact failure mode.

ui_bugs.issue: Console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' in History component render - non-blocking, cosmetic only

action_items: PRIMARY BUG FIX CONFIRMED WORKING: chart now renders after selecting a stock on Trading page; all 4 API calls return 200.

Optional/low priority: consider applying the same 200-with-no_historical_data pattern (or at least avoiding raw 500) to /api/market/quote/{symbol} for resilience against transient Alpaca rate-limit errors, since it's called in the same Promise.all and could reintroduce a similar (though less severe) cascading failure.
Optional/cosmetic: fix React list key warning on History page component.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_bars() fix (200 + no_historical_data flag on exception) is correctly implemented and verified via curl + browser network tab - matches the described root cause and fix exactly.

get_quote() (line 1050-1059) still raises HTTPException(500) on any exception, including transient Alpaca rate-limit errors - same class of bug as the one just fixed for get_bars, just not yet manifesting via Cloudflare HTML replacement since 500 isn't intercepted the same way. Low priority given it's intermittent.

success_rate.backend: 100% (bars/quote endpoints all returned 200 in E2E test)

Only new minor finding is the quote endpoint's un-fixed 500 exception path, which shares the same cascading-failure risk pattern as the original bug but wasn't in scope for this session.
